text:
Maya: short thread - run-history UX for structured output/tool-calls. want quick takes.

Maya: goals: clear producer label, small schema metadata, handle big arrays, keyboard + SR friendly.

Maya: idea 1: compact pill next to fn name: 'invoice-parser • v2' + tiny match indicator and collapsed JSON expand on focus/click.

Maya: idea 2: top-level field pills with type icon (str/num/obj/arr). click opens right sheet with schema+examples. fewer lines in timeline.

Maya: idea 3: minimal header row showing 'produced-by' and 'schema v#' + 3-dot menu -> View example. easiest.

Alex: prefer idea 1 for discoverability. array handling?

Samir: arrays -> show "array[n]" pill, preview first item. avoid full inline lists.

Jon: accessibility: no hover-only actions. pills must be keyboard-focusable; Enter/Space toggles; aria-expanded and aria-label like 'Structured output from invoice-parser: 3 fields'. match state needs text not just color.

Eve: copy tweak: use 'Structured output (fields may map to tool calls)'. match labels: 'Matches schema', 'Possible mismatch', 'No match' + icons. ensure AA contrast.

Alex: show small warning dot when backend match_score < 0.7 with tooltip linking to example.

Maya: will add truncate + focus reveal for long names, copy link action in 3-dot menu, and a reduce-motion preference for animation when opening full invocation.

PlaygroundBot: preview deployed https://staging.playground.redwood/preview/26123 (includes compact pill + keyboard demo).

Maya: thanks, i'll make an A/B figma and open PR with Jon's a11y checklist tomorrow.
